name: Curiosity Killed the Night
source:
A home once bought to cradle a new love now buries it beneath secrets soon to be uncovered.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
當初買下這個家，是為了讓一段剛萌芽的愛情在這裡生長。如今，這份愛卻被埋在了這個家即將揭開的重重秘密之下。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
